Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92585 AC 2 · “Consolidated view correctly aggregates all patients' tasks, attributed per patient”.

Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S12 Which patients' open tasks are in the view: Nursing Home on vs off Today's Visits; Hospital encounter complete

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U6 Nursing Home open tasks persist across visits (UAT 3.6: open tasks persist until changed) (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.6; TFA-92585 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Standard fixture; the agent adds an open task on the resident; a seeded Hospital patient whose encounter is complete with a kept open task

When Open Nursing Home Task Export; take the resident off Today's Visits (All Residents toggle) and open Task Export again; put it back. Open Hospital Task Export

Then Every class keeps its open task on the view: resident on Today's Visits, resident off Today's Visits, Hospital patient with the encounter marked complete

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 'every open task across all patients' + AC 2 + AC 10: cp1, cp2 mustContain {snfResident} and 'Schedule podiatry visit'. Main hides residents not on Today's Visits (Tim's spec pins it), so cp2 is expected to fail and is reported under Q1. The Hospital encounter-complete class ('QA Hosp Dan Ito', 'Arrange outpatient echo') is in spec.deferred and runs once seeding exists; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
